text: Implemented Phase 8. spatial.Domain now exposes a semantic DomainLocus; Region lowers canonically to ROI demand while Selection preserves requested row order; wrong same-sized domains are rejected; surface masks require exact ordered topology; geometric VoxelRegion is now VoxelBox with deprecated compatibility; ExactSpatialMap, CrispSpatialRelation, and sampled SpatialOperator remain distinct. DatasetAcquisitionDomain provides semantic time/full/active spaces, active-to-full Injection and checked reverse, ordered locus-backed resolution, explicit StructuralCompatibility, and exact image-selection adaptation while retaining All versus AllSpatial policy. Verification: spatialJVM/test 132 passed, spatialJS/test 109 passed, datasetJVM/test 81 passed, datasetJS/test 55 passed, warning-clean.
